name: SentryForge Detection Coverage
description: Detection coverage for the SentryForge (Wazuh Edition) project. Green techniques have a live, custom-deployed detection rule, validated against real captured attack fixtures and confirmed firing on genuine endpoint activity. Yellow techniques were deliberately investigated and NOT given a custom rule, with the reasoning documented (either sufficient built-in Wazuh coverage already exists, or the available log data does not support a more specific detection).

techniques.comment: Custom rule 110001. Detects sudo directly executing /bin/bash. Chained via if_sid off Wazuh's base sudo rule (5400). Live-tested and deployed via CI/CD.

Custom rule 110000. Detects a bash process directly issuing a connect() syscall (reverse shell signature). Chained off the auditd base rule (80700), matching audit.exe + audit.syscall together. Live-tested and deployed via CI/CD.

Custom rule 110002. Frequency/timeframe correlation (3 failures / 15s) chained off sshd's own failure rule (5760), catching a fast-burst gap in Wazuh's built-in brute-force rule (5551, tuned for 8 failures / 180s). Live-tested with a real Hydra run and deployed via CI/CD.

Investigated, deliberately not implemented. The crontab syslog message only records that a change occurred, never the entry's content (confirmed via wazuh-logtest: 'No decoder matched'). File Integrity Monitoring diff capture was tested as an alternative but does not work here, since crontab replaces its file atomically rather than editing in place. Wazuh's built-in rule 2833 already covers the only signal actually available at this log layer.

legendItems.label: Live custom detection (implemented + tested + deployed via CI/CD)
